findings.title: Missing standalone DPA for cross-border data transfer
findings.deviation: Clause 13.1 requires compliance with laws of properties outside India but does not incorporate a formal standalone Data Processing Agreement with standard clauses for cross-border transfers from UAE and Oman.
findings.impact: Processing personal data from UAE and Oman hotels without a formal DPA containing statutory cross-border transfer clauses may lead to compliance issues under foreign data laws.
findings.quote: 13.1 AtliQ shall process personal data contained in Client Data only for the purposes of the Pilot and in accordance with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and any other applicable data protection law, including the laws applicable to Properties located outside India.
findings.counterPosition: Execute a standalone Data Processing Agreement incorporating standard contractual clauses for cross-border data transfers for the UAE and Oman properties.

findings.title: Pre-existing IP license does not state it is perpetual
findings.deviation: Clause 8.2 grants a license for AtliQ's Pre-existing IP but does not explicitly specify that the license is perpetual, unlike AtliQ's standard which requires a perpetual license for background IP in deliverables.
findings.impact: The client's right to use AtliQ's pre-existing software or tools embedded in the dashboards could be interpreted as temporary or co-terminus with the agreement.
findings.quote: Each Party retains all rights in its Pre-existing IP. AtliQ grants BlueOrchid a non-exclusive, non-transferable, royalty-free licence to use AtliQ's Pre-existing IP to the extent incorporated in the Deliverables, solely for BlueOrchid's internal business purposes.
findings.counterPosition: Explicitly state that the license to AtliQ's Pre-existing IP is perpetual and irrevocable.

fine.note: Liquidated damages match the playbook's standard (0.5% per week, capped at 5% of the affected milestone, sole remedy, and client delays excluded).
Payment terms of 30 days for undisputed invoices are within the acceptable 30-45 days limit, and there is no pay-when-paid or broad set-off.
The aggregate liability cap is mutual and limited to 1x fees paid or payable, with standard exceptions (confidentiality, fraud, and wilful misconduct).
Indemnification is mutual for breach and negligence, and the IP infringement indemnity is standard and appropriately subject to the liability cap.
Termination for convenience requires 30 days' notice and ensures AtliQ is paid for all work performed, including pro-rata for milestones in progress.
Confidentiality obligations are mutual with an acceptable 3-year survival period.
The contract contains no restrictive covenants (such as non-compete or non-solicit provisions) targeting AtliQ.
No burdensome or unverified insurance requirements are imposed on AtliQ.
No complex or multi-staged acceptance procedures are present, with a simple 30-day warranty correction period instead.
The contract is silent on set-off, meaning the client has no contractual right to withhold payments unilaterally.
